hebrewText: עַד בֹּאִ/י֩ וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֗ם אֶרֶץ֩ דָּגָ֨ן וְ/תִיר֜וֹשׁ אֶ֧רֶץ לֶ֣חֶם וּ/כְרָמִ֗ים אֶ֣רֶץ זֵ֤ית יִצְהָר֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ וִֽ/חְי֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א תָמֻ֑תוּ וְ/אַֽל תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּֽי יַסִּ֤ית אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֖ה יַצִּילֵֽ/נוּ

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.
tokens.explanation: as far (or long

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.
tokens.explanation: to take

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: properly, increase, i.e. grain
tokens.kjv: corn (floor), wheat.
tokens.explanation: properly

tokens.bdb: must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine
tokens.kjv: (new, sweet) wine.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: must or fresh grape-juice ; by implication  fermented wine

tokens.bdb: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
tokens.kjv: (shew-) bread, [idiom] eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals.
tokens.explanation: food

tokens.bdb: a garden or vineyard
tokens.kjv: vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also H1021 (בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם).
tokens.explanation: a garden or vineyard

tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry
tokens.kjv: olive (tree, -yard), Olivet.
tokens.explanation: an olive

tokens.bdb: oil (as producing light); figuratively, anointing
tokens.kjv: [phrase] anointed oil.
tokens.explanation: oil ; figuratively

tokens.bdb: honey (from its stickiness); by analogy, syrup
tokens.kjv: honey(-comb).
tokens.explanation: honey ; by analogy

tokens.bdb: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
tokens.kjv: keep (leave, make) alive, [idiom] certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, ([idiom] God) save (alive, life, lives), [idiom] surely, be whole.
tokens.explanation: to live

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, [idiom] crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), [idiom] must needs, slay, [idiom] surely, [idiom] very suddenly, [idiom] in (no) wise.
tokens.explanation: to die ; causatively

tokens.bdb: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
tokens.kjv: nay, neither, [phrase] never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.
tokens.explanation: not (the qualified negation

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] attentively, call (gather) together, [idiom] carefully, [idiom] certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, [idiom] diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), [idiom] indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, [idiom] surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.
tokens.enLiteralWord: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.explanation: shama — ouvir, escutar, obedecer, prestar atenção
tokens.explanationEn: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites
tokens.kjv: Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare H3169 (יְחִזְקִיָּה).
tokens.explanation: Chizkijah

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: properly, to prick, i.e. (figuratively) stimulate; by implication, to seduce
tokens.kjv: entice, move, persuade, provoke, remove, set on, stir up, take away.
tokens.explanation: properly

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.
tokens.explanation: amar — dizer, falar, declarar, ordenar

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, [idiom] without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, [idiom] surely, take (out).
tokens.explanation: to snatch away
